name: What electrical upgrades are common for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What electrical upgrades are common for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common electrical upgrades for bathrooms include installing new GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlets for enhanced safety, upgrading to energy-efficient LED lighting, adding dimmer switches for adjustable ambiance, and installing dedicated circuits for high-power appliances like jetted tubs or sauna heaters. Ventilation fan upgrades, often with integrated lighting or humidity sensors, are also popular to improve air quality and prevent mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common bathroom electrical upgrades include GFCI outlets, LED lighting, dimmer switches, dedicated circuits for high-power appliances, and upgraded ventilation fans.
